preconditions.description: Length of string s is between 1 and 200,000.
Length of string t is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ab' for c in s)
preconditions.description: String s consists only of the characters 'a' and 'b'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ab' for c in t)
preconditions.description: String t consists only of the characters 'a' and 'b'.

preconditions.expression: any(c == 'a' for c in s) and any(c == 'b' for c in s)
preconditions.description: String s contains at least one 'a' and at least one 'b'.

preconditions.expression: any(c == 'a' for c in t) and any(c == 'b' for c in t)
preconditions.description: String t contains at least one 'a' and at least one 'b'.

postconditions.description: The number of operations n is between 0 and 500,000.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= ai <= len(s) for ai, _ in return_value[1:])
postconditions.description: Each ai is a valid prefix length of s.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= bi <= len(t) for _, bi in return_value[1:])
postconditions.description: Each bi is a valid prefix length of t.

postconditions.expression: any(all(c == 'a' for c in s) and all(c == 'b' for c in t)) or any(all(c == 'b' for c in s) and all(c == 'a' for c in t))
postconditions.description: After performing the swaps, one string consists only of 'a's and the other consists only of 'b's.
